snippet.title: 1348 EX VOTO - Launch trailer
snippet.description:
The time has come to honor your vow 📿 1348 Ex Voto is NOW AVAILABLE: https://www.1348exvoto.com
Brave the harsh realities of the Italian late medieval period in 1348 Ex Voto, a cinematic action-adventure game inspired by chivalric tales, launching NOW on Steam, Epic Games and PS5.

1348 Ex Voto is an indie game, developed by Sedleo and published by Dear Villagers.

Follow us:
• X: https://x.com/1348ExVoto
• Discord: https://discord.gg/dearvillagers
